results.title: Normally independent sets in the free group of rank two
results.caption: Definition

results.title: Minimal number of generators of a subgroup
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a subgroup $H$ of a group $G$, the minimal number of generators of $H$ is the least natural number $n$ such that $H$ is generated by some finite set of $n$ elements of $G$; it is $0$ when $H$ is not finitely generated.

results.title: Rank of a group
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: The rank of a group $G$ is the supremum, in the natural numbers, of the minimal numbers of generators of the subgroups of $G$, where an unbounded set of natural numbers has supremum $0$. For a finite group $G$ it is the largest minimal number of generators of a subgroup of $G$.

results.title: Monster of the first kind
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A group $G$ is a *monster of the first kind* (V. P. Shunkov) when $G$ is infinite, $G$ has an element of order greater than $2$, and for every element $a$ of order greater than $2$ and every proper subgroup $H$ of $G$ there is $g \in G \setminus H$ such that $a$ and $g^{-1} a g$ generate $G$. results.title: Restricted sumset
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a natural number $h$ and a finite subset $A$ of an additive commutative monoid $G$, the restricted sumset $h^{\wedge} A$ is the set of all sums $\sum_{a \in B} a$ with $B$ an $h$-element subset of $A$, that is, the sums of $h$ distinct elements of $A$. In particular $0^{\wedge} A = \{0\}$.

results.title: Restricted signed sumset
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a natural number $h$ and a finite set $A$ of integers, the restricted signed sumset $h^{\wedge}_{\pm} A$ is the set of all integers $\sum_{a \in B} a - 2 \sum_{a \in N} a$, where $B$ ranges over the $h$-element subsets of $A$ and $N$ ranges over the subsets of $B$. These are the sums of the elements of $B$ in which the elements of $N$ are given a negative sign.

results.title: Coefficient description of the restricted sumset

results.title: Coefficient description of the restricted signed sumset

results.title: Kimberling's blocks form a prefix chain

results.caption: Structure
results.summary: For a natural number $m$, a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ consists of a summary bit vector of length $m$ and, for each $i < m$, a cluster bit vector of length $m$; bit $j$ of cluster $i$ records whether the element $im + j$ is stored. Unlike the fully recursive van Emde Boas tree over universes of size $2^{2^k}$, the summary and the clusters here are plain bit vectors, not…

results.title: Empty van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a natural number $m$, the empty van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ is the tree in which all $m$ summary bits and all $m^2$ cluster bits ($m$ clusters of $m$ bits each) are unset.

results.title: Membership in a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: An element $x$ of the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ is a member of a two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ when bit $x \bmod m$ of cluster $\lfloor x / m \rfloor$ of $t$ is set. The summary bits are not consulted.

results.title: Insertion into a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. Inserting $x$ into $t$ gives the tree obtained from $t$ by setting bit $x \bmod m$ of cluster $\lfloor x / m \rfloor$ and summary bit $\lfloor x / m \rfloor$, leaving every other bit unchanged.

results.title: Summary invariant of a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: A two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ with $m$ clusters is valid when, for every cluster index $i < m$, summary bit $i$ of $t$ is set exactly when cluster $i$ of $t$ is nonempty, that is, when some bit $j < m$ of cluster $i$ is set.

results.title: Set of stored elements of a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number. For a van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the set of stored elements of $t$ is the finite set of those elements of the universe that are members of $t$.

results.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree has no members
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every $m$ and every $x$ in the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, $x$ is not a member of the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over that universe.

results.title: An inserted element is a member of a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every $x$ in that universe, $x$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$.

results.title: Insertion into a van Emde Boas tree leaves other elements unchanged
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and all $x \ne y$ in that universe, $y$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$ if and only if $y$ is a member of $t$.

results.title: Membership after insertion into a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and all $x, y$ in that universe, $y$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$ if and only if $y = x$ or $y$ is a member of $t$.

results.title: Insertion into a van Emde Boas tree keeps existing members
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and all $x, y$ in that universe, if $y$ is a member of $t$, then $y$ is a member of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$.

results.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree is valid
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every natural number $m$, the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ satisfies the summary invariant: each summary bit is set exactly when its cluster is nonempty.

results.title: Insertion preserves validity of van Emde Boas trees
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every natural number $m$, every element $x$ of the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over that universe that satisfies the summary invariant (each summary bit is set exactly when its cluster is nonempty), the tree obtained from $t$ by inserting $x$ also satisfies the summary invariant.

results.title: The contents of a van Emde Boas tree are its members
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every $x$ in that universe, $x$ belongs to the finite set of stored elements of $t$ if and only if $x$ is a member of $t$.

results.title: Contents of the empty van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every natural number $m$, the set of stored elements of the empty van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ is empty.

results.title: Contents after insertion into a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. The set of stored elements of the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into $t$ is the set of stored elements of $t$ together with $x$. No validity assumption on $t$ is needed.

results.title: Minimum query of a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: Let $t$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If some summary bit of $t$ is set, let $h$ be the least cluster index whose summary bit is set; if cluster $h$ has a set position, let $\ell$ be the least one. The minimum query on $t$ then returns the element $h \cdot m + \ell$. If no summary bit is set, or cluster $h$ has no set position, it returns no element.

results.title: The van Emde Boas minimum is stored
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $t$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If the minimum query on $t$ returns $x$, then $x$ is stored in $t$.

results.title: The van Emde Boas minimum is a lower bound
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If the minimum query on $t$ returns $x$, then $x \le y$ for every $y$ stored in $t$.

results.title: Empty minimum query in a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. The minimum query on $t$ returns no element if and only if no element of the universe is stored in $t$.

results.title: Characterization of the van Emde Boas minimum
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$ be in the universe. The minimum query on $t$ returns $x$ if and only if $x$ is stored in $t$ and $x \le y$ for every $y$ stored in $t$.

results.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree has no minimum
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every $m$, the minimum query of the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ returns no element.

results.title: Minimum of a one-element van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every $x$ in the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the minimum query on the two-level van Emde Boas tree obtained by inserting $x$ into the empty tree returns $x$.

results.title: Maximum query of a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Definition
results.summary: For a two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, the maximum query first finds the greatest index $i < m$ whose summary bit is set, and then the greatest index $j < m$ whose bit is set in cluster $i$; it returns the element $i m + j$. It returns no element if no summary bit is set, or if no bit of cluster $i$ is set. When the summary bits record exactly the nonempty clusters,…

results.title: The maximum query of a van Emde Boas tree returns a member
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every two-level van Emde Boas tree $t$ over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and every $x$ in that universe, if the maximum query of $t$ returns $x$, then $x$ is a member of $t$. No validity hypothesis on $t$ is needed.

results.title: The van Emde Boas maximum query bounds every member
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $t$ be a valid van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. If the maximum query on $t$ returns $x$, then $y \le x$ for every member $y$ of $t$.

results.title: When the van Emde Boas maximum query returns nothing
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $t$ be a valid van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. The maximum query on $t$ returns no element if and only if no element of the universe is a member of $t$.

results.title: Correctness of the van Emde Boas maximum query
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number, let $t$ be a valid van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. The maximum query on $t$ returns $x$ if and only if $x$ is a member of $t$ and $y \le x$ for every member $y$ of $t$.

results.title: Maximum query on the empty van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every natural number $m$, the maximum query on the empty van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ returns no element.

results.title: Maximum query on a one-element van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $m$ be a natural number and let $x$ be an element of the universe $\{0, 1, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$. The maximum query on the tree obtained by inserting $x$ into the empty van Emde Boas tree over this universe returns $x$.

results.title: The van Emde Boas successor is stored
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $y$ is a member of $T$.

results.title: The van Emde Boas successor is strictly larger than its argument
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $x < y$.

results.title: No member lies strictly between an element and its van Emde Boas successor
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$, $y$, $z$ be elements of the universe. If the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$ and $z$ is a member of $T$ with $x < z$, then $y \le z$.

results.title: A van Emde Boas successor is missing exactly when nothing larger is stored
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ be an element of the universe. Then $x$ has no successor in $T$ if and only if every member $z$ of $T$ satisfies $z \le x$.

results.title: The van Emde Boas successor is the least larger member
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$ and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. Then the successor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$ if and only if $y$ is a member of $T$, $x < y$, and $y \le z$ for every member $z$ of $T$ with $x < z$.

results.title: The empty van Emde Boas tree has no successors
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: For every $m$ and every element $x$ of the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, $x$ has no successor in the empty two-level van Emde Boas tree over that universe.

results.title: The van Emde Boas predecessor is stored
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the predecessor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $y$ is a member of $T$.

results.title: The van Emde Boas predecessor is strictly smaller than its argument
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $T$ be a two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, not necessarily valid, and let $x$ and $y$ be elements of the universe. If the predecessor of $x$ in $T$ is $y$, then $y < x$.

results.title: Maximality of the van Emde Boas predecessor
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$, $y$ and $z$ be in the universe. If the predecessor query for $x$ in $t$ returns $y$, and $z$ is stored in $t$ with $z < x$, then $z \le y$.

results.title: Empty predecessor query in a van Emde Boas tree
results.caption: Theorem
results.summary: Let $t$ be a valid two-level van Emde Boas tree over the universe $\{0, \dots, m^2 - 1\}$, and let $x$ be in the universe. The predecessor query for $x$ in $t$ returns no element if and only if $x \le z$ for every $z$ stored in $t$.

results.title: Characterization of the van Emde Boas predecessor
